features.title: GitHub OAuth login and session
features.user_visible_behavior: User clicks 'Login with GitHub', is redirected to GitHub, authorizes, and returns to the app as a logged-in user with their avatar visible in the nav.
verification: Start both frontend and server.
Click 'Login with GitHub' in the nav.
Complete GitHub OAuth flow.
Verify the nav shows the user's name and avatar.
Verify /api/user/me returns a 200 with user data.
evidence: Committed in b16bae5 (auth changes) and dfceb90 (OAuth login restricted).
features.notes: OAuth scope restricted to read-only. Session managed via express-session + connect-pg-simple.

features.title: Encrypt GitHub tokens at rest
features.user_visible_behavior: GitHub OAuth access tokens stored in the database are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The app still functions normally — the encryption/decryption is transparent.
verification: Set TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY in server/.env.
Log in via GitHub OAuth.
Inspect the token column in the database — it must NOT be plaintext.
Verify /api/summary/ still works (token decrypted successfully at runtime).
Verify /api/repo/ still returns the user's repos.
features.notes: server/lib/encryption.ts exists but all code is commented out. Committed as 'encryption in progress' (be29f3e). Needs TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var added and encrypt/decrypt wired into the OAuth callback and token retrieval path.

features.title: Recap UI redesign (Recap.html design, branch: upgrating-ui)
features.user_visible_behavior: The app has a polished developer-dark UI: split-panel login with terminal animation, ⌘K command-palette repo picker, AI summary view with narrative, stat cards with sparklines, commit bar chart, PR donut chart, contributor bars, key themes, and suggested next actions.
verification: Run npm run dev.
Open http://localhost:3000 — dark split-panel login screen renders.
Click 'Continue with GitHub' — redirects to GitHub OAuth.
After OAuth, app screen loads: TopBar with user avatar, ⌘K hint.
Repo list loads in command palette — search/arrow-key navigation works.
Select a repo — 'Gemini is analyzing…' skeleton renders, then full summary view.
Summary view shows: narrative card, 4 stat cards, commit bar chart, PR donut, themes, next actions.
Toggle 7d/30d — summary regenerates.
⌘K opens palette modal over summary view.
Click regenerate button — summary refreshes.
evidence: npx next build: PASSED cleanly 2026-06-13, no CSS warnings
Bug fixed: removed @import tailwindcss — caused infinite Turbopack error loop in dev mode freezing browser
features.notes: Design source: Recap.html from claude.ai/design handoff bundle. Components in app/components/. Backend summary.ts enhanced for structured JSON output. End-to-end browser test requires live GitHub OAuth.

features.title: Repository listing

verification: Log in via GitHub OAuth.
Verify the repo selector dropdown is populated.
Verify GET /api/repo/ returns a JSON array of repos.
evidence: Working as of commit 6477efd ('Now the github tracker app is working fine').

features.title: AI activity summary (Gemini)
features.user_visible_behavior: User selects a repository, clicks 'Generate Summary', and sees a natural-language summary of the last 7 days of activity.
verification: Log in via GitHub OAuth.
Select a repository from the dropdown.
Click 'Generate Summary'.
Verify a text summary appears under 'Last 7 Days Summary'.
Verify a Gemini 503 returns the retry prompt instead of crashing.
features.notes: Uses @google/genai. 503 errors show a retry button in the UI.
